[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/xxyx-client-api\.xiaoxiaoyouxuan\.com\/get_big_module_bottom_ad/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/xxyx-client-api\.xiaoxiaoyouxuan\.com\/get_index_activity_list_ad/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/xxyx-client-api\.xiaoxiaoyouxuan\.com\/bottom_banner/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/xxyx-client-api\.xiaoxiaoyouxuan\.com\/new_banner\?/i then reject(404)
# 多余模块
# ^https:\/\/xxyx-client-api\.xiaoxiaoyouxuan\.com\/vajra reject-dict
# 弹窗广告
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/xxyx-client-api\.xiaoxiaoyouxuan\.com\/agent_ad/i then reject(404)
# 右下角的悬浮广告
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/xxyx-client-api\.xiaoxiaoyouxuan\.com\/activity\/show/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/xxyx-client-api\.xiaoxiaoyouxuan\.com\/client\/urban\/activity\/index\/data\?agentId=12/i then reject(404)
# 禁止上报设备信息
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/statistic\.live\.126\.net\/statics\/report\/common\/form/i then reject(404)


[MITM]
hostname = xxyx-client-api.xiaoxiaoyouxuan.com, statistic.live.126.net
